assessment: Both real configuration consumers share a bounded owned-file reader. O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK and descriptor fstat reject symlink/FIFO/nonregular/non-0600/unowned input; allocation/read bound remains 65537 bytes and fatal UTF-8 parsing has a generic nonsecret error.

Strict host policy allows only canonical absolute roots, bounded store IDs and at most 512 SHA256 digests. No request or JSON field can invent executionSettled proof. Missing config disables installation routes.

Factory migration 029 follows existing 028 and completes before scheduler/serving. Existing owner-auth hook governs the optional routes. Approved domain remains the sole operation, quota, lifecycle and state authority.

CLI mutation commands require the caller stable key and use bounded strict JSON input. Public client paths/auth/signal are reused without retry or replacement keys. Conflict exits 3; transport/abort exits 4; malformed/missing input exits 2.

Production test uses actual createServer and public HTTP/CLI with a loopback registry, trusted config and dedicated random PostgreSQL database. It verifies routes disabled by default, 029, static installation, denied runner/invalid credential, persisted receipt replay after factory restart, no second download, and runtime unavailable.
Teardown preserves identity checks and verifies owners closed, connections empty, database dropped and owned root removed. Installed material is never asserted enabled, loaded or callable.
